title: Resolving the Identity Crisis in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the duplication of faces in multi-human generated images by extracting facial embeddings (using RetinaFace and ArcFace) and computing cosine similarities to calculate Unique Face Accuracy (UFA) within single images and Global Identity Spread (GIS) across generated samples.

Evaluating model performance on the DiverseHumans test set using prompts categorized by diversity tags, specifically measuring how well models maintain identity diversity when given prompts with 'Single ethnicity specifications' versus 'Individual ethnicity assignments'.
